Welcome to Redemption!

We are very excited to get our server started! With hard work and dedication, and the support of our amazing community, we hope to provide you with an unparalleled minecraft experience. Keep an eye out for new features, minigames and special events.

Our server is based off 5 main features

Anarchy: We love the idea of anarchy! Knowing that there is no safe point in the world, and being allowed to cause destruction, stealing, and manipulating players will always keep things interesting and very exciting!

MCMMO: We wanted to have mcmmo installed on our server to give more purpose other than what just vanilla minecraft has to offer. With MCMMO you can choose to level up on certain skills, so you can become more efficient at either your pvp fights, or resouce gathering. It also opens up opportunities for new types of farms! All this while staying in the means of vanilla minecraft, so no special items or anything that grants you too much of an advantage.

Economy: Being able to have in game money on the server can open a veriaty of different ways of playing, and gathering resources. We want you to be able to cash in on whatever you may mine, so you can eventualy buy yourself that spawn egg so you can have different mob farms. Or maybe save up so you can buy that dye that is so hard to come by. Or maybe you just want to be known for having the most money on the server, and want to buy peoples trust? It's all up to you!

PvP: With a combination of your pvp skills and time spent on the server, you can come up with many different ways to pvp other players on here, be it in the arena, or stalking someone in the overworld. If you see someone in an area that they can be killed in, and you desperately want their items? We encourage you to take it!

Silk Touch Spawners: Silk Touch is an enchant you can get randomly from the enchanting table or through an enchanting book. With an enchanted Silk Touch pickax you can pick up spawners which can then be used to make farms, grinders, ect. You can find mob eggs for sale inside our egg shop, mob eggs can be used to change the spawner type.

**Daily Devotional**

**January 8**

*6 Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. 7 And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. (Philippians 4:6-7 KJV)*

This is saying that we should not be anxious about anything, but we should give our cares to the Lord by prayer and supplication. Notice that it says we should do this with thanksgiving, and that is so very important, as being thankful to God for His goodness is showing that we appreciate all He does for us, and it blesses God for His children to be thankful to Him. We need to be full of praise and thanksgiving when we pray to the Lord (Psalms 100:4) and most Christians are not very good at showing how much we appreciate all God does for us.

This verse is saying that the peace of God is beyond our ability to understand with our limited brains, as it is a peace that can only come from God, and is beyond anything that we can imagine. When you truly understand the love of God, and get full of His love, then the peace and joy that comes upon you, is something that can not be compared with anything else in this world. It is a peace and contentment that makes everything else in the world become unimportant, as all that matters is pleasing God, and knowing that His love will carry you through everything that the devil (John 10:10) and this world can throw at you. It is truly beyond explanation. If you have been born again, you have God’s love and peace in your new spirit, as it is a fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23). Thank you Lord for giving us your love to share with others.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
